name: Quick settings
description: Network, Bluetooth, sound and battery in one place on the panel, and quick settings a click away: Wi-Fi and Ethernet, Bluetooth, the microphone, do not disturb, Night Light, and game mode and VPN where there are any, with the volume and the brightness -- each with a page of its own for the devices behind it. Choose which tiles are drawn. Scroll to change the volume, middle-click to mute.

tiles.label: Tiles
tiles.description: Which switches the grid draws, in this order. A tile for hardware the machine does not have is left out whether or not it is on here -- no Bluetooth adapter, no Bluetooth tile.

density.label: Quick settings
density.description: roomy: a grid of tiles. dense: a list of rows, each with its switch.

step.label: Volume step
step.description: Percent per notch of the wheel.
